about: Modules for S3-PO, installed from its Modules page or with the command "install <name>".

modules.name: Crypto price
modules.about: Watches a cryptocurrency (CoinGecko) and pushes when its price rises above or falls below your thresholds, or moves a lot in 24 hours.

modules.name: Fuel prices
modules.about: Fuel prices for Germany (Tankerkönig) and Austria (E-Control), with a push when a station drops to your limit.

modules.name: Game Night Oracle
modules.about: Keeps score for your Board Game Night group: briefings with S3-PO's odds, winners with streaks, a monthly recap.

modules.name: Game nights
modules.about: A push when a day on your Board Game Night calendar reaches "Game on", when it's off again, and a reminder the day before.

modules.name: Hello world (example)
modules.about: An example for module writers: a daily greeting, a check counter and a dice command. Sends nothing useful.

modules.name: Nintendo Store stock
modules.about: Watches a product on the Nintendo Store and pushes the moment it can be bought (and when the store opens a waiting room).

modules.name: Waste collection
modules.about: A reminder the evening before a waste pickup, plus notices like recycling centre closures, from an iCal calendar.

modules.name: Weather
modules.about: Official DWD weather warnings for your place (storms louder, even in quiet hours) and a morning forecast. Germany.

modules.name: Zelda concerts
modules.about: A push when the Zelda 40th Anniversary Concert tour adds a date in your countries, and when its tickets change.
